Impacted Systems: Systems using vulnerable versions of the 'activerecord' RubyGem
Attack Vector: Without sufficient escaping or sanitization of SQL statements, generated SQL query can cause inputs to be interpreted as SQL commands instead of ordinary user data by the processing engine
Indicators of Compromise: Manipulation of less than well-written SQL code for nefarious purposes. A software component that fails to properly construct all or part of a SQL command or incorrectly neutralizes (or fails to neutralize) specific elements that could modify that SQL command
